transcript: Speaker A: दादा, न्यू मार्केट जाने का कितना लोगे? [Grandfather, how much will you take to go to New Market?] Speaker B: It will be around ’80. Speaker A: ’80 तो थोड़ा ज़्यादा हो रहा है दादा। [’80 is a bit too much, grandfather.] Speaker B: If you can't afford it, then find some other rickshaw. Please. Speaker A: दादा, एक बात बताइए। मैं अपनी मम्मी को English सिखाने की कोशिश कर रही हूँ पर वो practice नहीं कर पाती। आपने कैसे English सीखी? [Grandfather, tell me one thing. I am trying to teach my mother English but she can't practice. How did you learn English?] Speaker B: मैं तो SpeakEasy app यूज़ करता हूँ। [I use the SpeakEasy app.] Speaker A: SpeakEasy app? वो क्या है? [SpeakEasy app? What is that?] Speaker B: इस app में एक AI teacher है। उसके साथ रोज़ 10-15 मिनट practice करके मैंने English सीख ली। [There is an AI teacher in this app. By practicing with her for 10-15 minutes daily, I learned English.] Speaker A: अरे वाह! पर ये AI teacher तो बहुत महँगी होगी ना? You should get your mother started too.] Speaker A: ज़रूर दादा। कैसे शुरू करूँ? [Sure, grandfather. summary: A young woman is surprised when an elderly rickshaw puller speaks fluent English. He explains that he learned it by practicing 10-15 minutes daily with an AI teacher on the SpeakEasy app, which costs only 1 rupee to start. The ad ends with an AI presenter encouraging viewers to download the app and start a 15-day English challenge.
